messages.author: bfbd6e1b86db2599
messages.subject: ML with ordered variables
parts:
Hello,
I am assessing the construct validity of a scale that has been proposed at one- two- and three-factor levels. All the questions are five level ordered variables. While I have successfully used lavaan to get all the model fit indices, I have been unable to run BIC or AIC to compare the models as when I attempt to use  estimator="ML" I am told that it is not yet covered for ordinal data. I cannot then get the loglik either. Is there any other way to compute out the BIC or better way to compare the models aside from choosing the best composite of indices. Thanks so much.

alden

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: ML with ordered variables
parts:
No, information criteria are calculated from likelihoods, so they are not available for least-squares estimators.

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Postdoctoral Researcher, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
